old_problem: The Procedure is only a vendor label and the no-error acceptance sits in Script, so a guessed command or final-state check could miss whether 500 genuine Gen4-to-Gen5 transactions occurred.
disposition_reason: Criteria and Script jointly define the transition pair, count, required width/speed and no-error oracle. The owner-pinned vendor primitive, path, Gen4-entry mechanism, limits and recovery can be runtime Project Configuration. This removes review Pending without guessing syntax or reducing named-case coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2111 including Items, Procedure, Criteria, Script and DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2112 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00033-V002 / 2941ca882a7e21f7 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Speed Change 45 is bound to the Criteria-defined 500 Gen4-to-Gen5 transactions and Script-defined full-width/speed no-error outcome.
The numeric label is not executable syntax: bind a signed LTSSM/NVQual primitive and immutable Gen5-capable topology before any action.
For every entry prove Gen4/full-width start, then capture the Gen5 request, equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settle deadline, final width/speed, enumeration and fresh error/health deltas.
Count only complete durable entries; an already-Gen5 link, reduced width, one final snapshot or another speed-change row cannot satisfy this case.
Stop before the next request on mapping mismatch, invalid start, unsupported Gen5, failed/late/downtrained training, device loss, new disqualifying error/reset, evidence gap or safety anomaly.
Preserve baseline and first-fault evidence, never clear or automatically retry, and use only approved recovery.
No vendor command, LTSSM/NVQual action, speed change, retraining, PCIe query, recovery, retry or DUT operation was performed.

test_case.test_name: Owner-bound Speed Change 45: 500 verified Gen4-to-Gen5 transactions
test_case.purpose: Prove five hundred genuine full-width Gen4-to-Gen5 transitions on the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe path with the authoritative Speed Change 45 primitive and no disqualifying errors.
required_package: Owner-signed NVIDIA LTSSM/NVQual Speed Change 45 build, command and configuration implementing Gen4-to-Gen5
Immutable Gen5-capable PCIe hierarchy/lane map and expected width
Dedicated SUT, durable ledger/interlock, console, stable power/cooling and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration maps Speed Change 45 to the Criteria-defined Gen4-to-Gen5 primitive. Preserve baselines; after point approval execute only that primitive for entries 1..500. Prove Gen4/full width before every request; capture Gen5 request, equalization/LTSSM, settled speed/width, enumeration, errors and health before enabling the next entry. Stop on first mismatch, fault or evidence gap; do not clear or retry.
test_case.expected_result: The pinned primitive is traceably Gen4-to-Gen5, and all 500 entries independently prove full-width Gen4 start and Gen5 settle within the signed envelope, with required devices present and no disqualifying new PCIe/GPU/host/BMC/thermal/power error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until Speed Change 45 semantics, tool, topology, capability, start method and limits are approved. PASS then requires 500 complete accepted records. FAIL on primitive/scope mismatch, invalid start, unsupported/late/wrong/reduced target, device loss, disqualifying error/reset or failed recovery. Missing input/artifact is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until the vendor primitive, tool/path, Gen4-start proof, Gen5 capability/target, acceptance/interlock and recovery are signed.
Use an isolated SUT with console, stable power/cooling and point authorization.
Durably preserve every start, equalization/transition and final state plus raw error evidence.
Stop without retry on first semantic, state, capability, link/device, error/evidence or safety anomaly.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed Speed Change 45-to-Gen4/Gen5 mapping
Pinned tool/configuration and complete Gen5-capable path/lane map
Gen4-start plus Gen5 equalization/full-width/deadline/error contract and pre-test health baseline
Ledger 1..500 with raw start, request, LTSSM/equalization, settled Gen5/width, enumeration, timestamps and result
Per-cycle AER/kernel/GPU/BMC/thermal/power correlation and completeness audit
First-fault/recovery or clean final topology/health, no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On mapping mismatch, invalid Gen4 entry, unsupported or failed/late/downtrained Gen5, endpoint/sibling loss, disqualifying error/reset or artifact gap, inhibit later requests and preserve the first event. Do not substitute another speed-change primitive or retry; follow signed recovery and quarantine if topology/health is not restored.
